text:
Three stages: deps → build → runtime.

```dockerfile
# ---- Stage 1: Install deps ----
FROM node:22-alpine AS deps
WORKDIR /app

COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --ignore-scripts

# ---- Stage 2: Compile TypeScript ----
FROM deps AS build
WORKDIR /app

COPY tsconfig*.json ./
COPY src/ ./src/
RUN npm run build        # emits to /app/dist
RUN npm prune --omit=dev # strip devDeps in-place

# ---- Stage 3: Runtime ----
FROM node:22-alpine AS runtime
ENV NODE_ENV=production
WORKDIR /app

# Non-root user. Alpine already has 'node' user (uid 1000).
USER node

COPY --from=build --chown=node:node /app/dist      ./dist
COPY --from=build --chown=node:node /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=build --chown=node:node /app/package.json ./

EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
```

---

## Why each choice

| Decision | Reason |
|----------|--------|
| `alpine` base | ~5 MB vs ~200 MB slim/bullseye |
| `npm ci` | Reproducible. Fails on lockfile mismatch |
| Stage 1 copy `package*.json` only | Layer cache survives src changes |
| `npm prune --omit=dev` in build stage | devDeps gone before copy to runtime |
| Copy `dist` + `node_modules` only | No src, no tsconfig, no tests in final |
| `USER node` | No root in prod |

---

## Expected sizes

```
deps      ~250 MB  (throw away)
build     ~300 MB  (throw away)
runtime   ~120 MB  ← only this ships
```

---

## Assumptions to adjust

**`tsconfig.json` must set `outDir: "./dist"`** — or change `CMD` to match your actual out path.

If `npm run build` calls `tsc` with `--project`, copy all relevant tsconfigs in stage 2.

Add `.dockerignore` or cache wrecked:

```
node_modules
dist
.git
*.md
```
